style_guidance.description: How this type's prompt should be steered stylistically

extra_fields.description: Extra prompt fields this type adds beyond the shared set, each mapped to guidance text

evaluation_criteria.description: Criteria this type's prompts are checked against, on top of the shared criteria

caveat.description: Known limitation, e.g. no currently integrated model supports this type well

name.description: Unique identifier for the criterion within its scope

check_type.description: 'structural' = deterministically computable; 'semantic' = requires an LLM-as-judge pass

severity.description: 'blocking' = gates generation; 'quality' = contributes to an aggregate score

weight.description: Relative importance (0-1) among quality criteria in the same scope; omit for blocking criteria

remediation.description: What the improve step should try when this criterion fails
